description: Disavow file management: mark one URL or domain for disavowal. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. entryType 'url' disavows exactly that page (value must be a full absolute URL); entryType 'domain' disavows the whole domain AND its subdomains (value is a bare host, no scheme) — per Google's own documented disavow-file format, there is no way to disavow just a subpath.

entryType.description: 'url' disavows one page; 'domain' disavows the whole domain and its subdomains.

note.description: Optional reason, written as a comment above the entry in the exported file.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

source.description: Where this entry came from. Defaults to 'manual'.

value.description: A full absolute URL for entryType 'url'; a bare domain (no scheme) for entryType 'domain'.

name: add_disavow_entry
